lore: A reclusive master of elemental manipulation, the Invoker once commanded the very fabric of existence. Drawn into the Spire's maddening influence, he seeks to reclaim ancient power, his arcane might a terrifying force against the Heart's corruption. Each orb he conjures hums with primordial energy, a testament to his unmatched intellect and ambition.
theme: Arcane elemental master, ancient power, aristocratic magic, primordial forces.

appearance.body: Tall, slender, and elegant, with a powerful, commanding posture. Long, graceful fingers.
appearance.clothing: Dark, flowing robes in deep sapphire blue with intricate antique golden embroidery along the seams, collar, and cuffs. A high, stiff collar and wide, dramatic sleeves that billow with movement. A heavy, ornate belt adorned with arcane symbols. The fabric appears rich and heavy, designed to catch light dramatically.
appearance.accessories: Three distinct elemental orbs (one icy blue, one fiery orange-red, one crackling electric yellow) constantly orbit him in a slow, mesmerizing dance, each pulsing with internal light. No visible staff or weapon, as his power emanates directly from the orbs.
appearance.face: Sharp, aristocratic features with high cheekbones and a stern, intellectual gaze. Long, flowing white-silver hair cascades over his shoulders, conveying a sense of timelessness and arcane energy. His eyes possess an intense, subtle glow (perhaps pale blue or gold).
appearance.silhouette: Distinctive due to the wide, flowing robes, high collar, and the three orbiting, luminous elemental orbs that create dynamic points of light around his form. The overall shape is elegant, imposing, and clearly magical.

colorPalette.primary: Deep sapphire blues, desaturated teals, and charcoal grays for his main robes. Rich, dark browns for any exposed skin. Antique, desaturated gold for embroidery and accents.
colorPalette.secondary: Vibrant, saturated ice blue for Quas orb and ice effects; fiery orange/crimson for Exort orb and fire effects; electric yellow/bright white for Wex orb and lightning effects.
colorPalette.accent: Brightest whites and intense glowing yellows/oranges/blues where the elemental magic impacts or erupts, and for the core glow of the orbs.
colorPalette.glow: Pure, intense, luminous versions of ice blue, fiery orange, and electric yellow, used for the elemental orbs themselves and the peak intensity of spell effects.

artStyle.lighting: Dramatic and directional, creating sharp contrasts and strong cast shadows. Light sources frequently emanate from his elemental orbs and spell effects, producing glowing effects and emphasizing dynamic action and power.
artStyle.renderStyle: painterly, STS2 style, 2D illustration, dark fantasy

animations.name: idle
animations.description: The Invoker stands with a commanding, slightly forward-leaning posture. His ornate robes subtly shift and flow as if stirred by unseen arcane winds. The three elemental orbs (icy blue, fiery orange, electric yellow) orbit him slowly and rhythmically, each pulsing with a soft, internal glow. His long white hair drifts gently. Dramatic, directional light catches the golden accents on his robes and the edges of his form, casting deep shadows.

animations.name: attack
animations.description: The Invoker thrusts both hands forward, his body leaning into the action with intense focus. The three elemental orbs rapidly converge towards his hands and then burst outwards as a concentrated blast of elemental energy (e.g., a fiery meteor, a chain lightning bolt, or an icy shard volley) erupts. Intense, vibrant glow emanates from the point of impact and his hands. Strong diagonal lines emphasize the forward thrust and power. Robes flare dramatically, and his hair whips back. The scene is momentarily dominated by the light of the magical discharge.

animations.name: hit
animations.description: The Invoker recoils sharply, a ripple of pain crossing his face. His body twists slightly away from the imaginary impact point. The elemental orbs flicker erratically and briefly dim, their orbit becoming momentarily chaotic and less defined. Robes are momentarily disheveled or pushed back. A sudden, sharp highlight appears on the side of impact, contrasting with deeper shadows on the opposite side, indicating a forceful blow.

animations.name: death
animations.description: The Invoker collapses to one knee, then slowly falls forward, his hands reaching out before him as his power drains. His ornate robes slump, losing their dynamic form and becoming heavy. The three elemental orbs lose their luminosity, fading into dull, dark spheres before dissipating entirely into wisps of smoke or light. His glowing eyes dim and close. The dramatic lighting slowly fades, leaving his form enveloped in growing shadows until he is completely dark.
